LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestRadiusToolTip: How far from the colonist to look for something to haul when a harvest finishes.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestSameWorkDistance: Haul before more of the same work beyond: {0} cells
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestSameWorkDistanceToolT: When the colonist's next job is more of the same work, but further away than this, they haul something nearby before walking over.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnablePlantsToolTip: Haul something nearby after harvesting crops and other plants.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestIncludeTreesToolTip: Haul something nearby after cutting plants and chopping trees.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableAnimalsToolTip: Haul something nearby after milking or shearing an animal.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableMiningToolTip: Haul something nearby after mining. Rock chunks nearby are hauled too, unmarked, when a stockpile accepts them.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableDeconstructTool: Haul something nearby after a run of deconstructing buildings.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableStripToolTip: Haul something nearby after a run of stripping corpses or downed pawns.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableSkullsToolTip: Haul something nearby after a run of extracting skulls.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestEnableFishingToolTip: Haul something nearby after a run of fishing.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestRequireHaulingToolTip: Colonists with the Hauling work type turned off go straight back to their other work.
LanguageData.TKSHaulAfterHarvestZoneDesc: When a colonist finishes harvesting or cutting in this zone, they haul something nearby to storage before moving on. Turn off to have them move straight on.
